description: Paid ($0.01 USDC). Look up one company worldwide in the official registers: GLEIF (Legal Entity Identifiers, every country) and US SEC EDGAR. By LEI: legal name, status, jurisdiction, addresses, registration authority, renewal dates and its registered direct and ultimate parent. By name: ranked matches, live registrations first, with legal forms understood across languages and names in their own script. By SEC CIK: filer profile, tickers and latest filings. Registry data only: not KYC, not a compliance determination, not legal advice. Payment: call once without payment_signature to get the exact price quote (nothing is charged or signed), then call again with the signed payment to receive the result and settlement details.

payment_signature.description: Optional. An x402 v2 payment you signed for this call's quote (the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value). Omit to get the price quote first; nothing is charged without it.

query.description: Company name (3 to 200 characters), 20-character LEI, or SEC CIK.

name: genesis402_company_lookup

also_accepted_networks.description: QUOTE_ONLY: every network the 402 challenge accepts.

how_to_pay.description: QUOTE_ONLY: how to sign and resend the call.

mode.description: QUOTE_ONLY: price quote only, nothing signed or charged. PAID: the call was paid and result holds the data. FREE: the endpoint answered without payment.

paid.description: true only when a payment was settled for this call.

payment_required_b64.description: QUOTE_ONLY: the raw base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, to sign with any x402 v2 client.

atomic.description: Price in USDC atomic units (6 decimals), as a decimal string.

network.description: CAIP-2 network id of the lane, eip155:8453 (Base).

price.description: The Base USDC quote. Present on QUOTE_ONLY and on PAID calls made by a local payer; null when the rail offered no Base USDC lane or the caller signed the payment.

resource.description: QUOTE_ONLY: the full URL of the paid resource.

result.description: PAID or FREE: the endpoint's JSON result.

settlement.description: PAID: decoded PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement (transaction hash, network, payer), or null if the rail sent none.

what_you_get.description: QUOTE_ONLY: the rail's description of what the payment buys.

title: Look up a company (GLEIF, SEC)
